title: CRUD App
description: A serverless notes application demonstrating database operations.
fulldescription:
This launches a classic AWS starter project: a fully functional serverless Notes application. It demonstrates the core principles of cloud-native apps: **Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD)**. 

Data is stored in **Amazon DynamoDB**, a fast NoSQL database. **AWS Lambda** functions handle the logic for saving and retrieving notes, while **Amazon API Gateway** provides a secure REST API interface protected by an API Key. The frontend is a static HTML/JS site hosted in a private **Amazon S3** bucket, served via presigned URLs. It is designed to be low-cost and completely serverless.

services.name: Amazon DynamoDB

services.desc: Runs the Python code to process API requests and manage data.

services.name: Amazon API Gateway
services.desc: Manages the REST API endpoints and enforces API Key security.
